prompts.lotus: Use case: precise-object-edit / seasonal sprite. Asset type: a reusable transparent pond-game prop. Preserve the overall triangular compact footprint and relative positions, strict 90-degree overhead orthographic camera, natural photographic botanical detail, fine radial veins, muted fresh green color and soft neutral daylight from upper left. A little natural irregularity but no damaged brown leaves. All leaves lie flat with no standing stalk, show the flower bud from directly above. Avoid low-poly triangles, graphic outlines, saturated neon colors, exaggerated waxy shine, giant droplets, long cast shadows, pot, ground, water patch, roots, base disk, other plants, text or symbols. Objects and overlaps only, no surrounding shadow plate. Entire cluster centered in a square with at least10percent fully transparent margin on every edge and genuine alpha in gaps.
